title: Crispy Hash Browns with Slovakian Twist
description: A French-inspired side dish with the crunch of crispy hash browns and the earthy flavors of Slovakian mushrooms.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add sliced mushrooms and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add diced onion and cook until crispy, about 2-3 minutes.
Grate potatoes and add to skillet, stirring to combine with mushroom mixture.
Season with thyme, hash brown seasoning, salt, and pepper.
Form mixture into a round shape and cook for 4-5 minutes, until crispy and golden brown.
Flip hash browns and cook for an additional 4-5 minutes, until crispy and golden brown.
